summary: You learn when a delegation points at an Azure resource or role that no longer exists.

new.title: A daily check of delegation targets
new.text: A new daily job checks that the Azure resources, scopes and roles your delegations use still exist. Missing ones are listed at the top of Coverage & gaps; you decide what to remove.

new.title: Mail when something disappears
new.text: New findings are mailed once to your alert recipients. You can switch the mail off under Alerting and change the schedule on the Jobs page.
